description: This Java class defines the 'Hook' entity in the Fineract project, representing a system hook with properties like name, active status, associated events, configuration, and templates. It includes methods for creating, updating, and associating related entities.

classes.name: Hook
classes.description: Entity class representing a system hook with properties, relationships, and methods for creation and updates.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Hook instance from JSON command, template, configurations, events, and template reference.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the hook's properties based on a JSON command, returning a map of changes.

methods.name: updateEvents
methods.description: Replaces existing events with new set of HookResource objects.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Replaces existing configuration with new set of HookConfiguration objects.

methods.name: getUgdTemplateId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated ugdTemplate if present.
